# Garzoni

> Garzoni is a personal finance education platform for young adults. It teaches budgeting, saving, investing, debt management, credit scores, and taxes through interactive ten-minute lessons, daily streaks, spaced repetition, and an AI-powered financial coach. Available on web, iOS and Android.

Garzoni is a learning platform — think "Duolingo for personal finance" — not a budgeting tracker. The goal is lasting financial literacy through short, practical, jargon-free lessons. Garzoni is a financial education app, not a registered financial adviser, and does not recommend specific financial products.

## Facts
- 150+ short lessons in 35 courses, across learning paths for budgeting, saving, investing, credit, taxes, real estate, crypto and forex.
- Languages: English and Romanian (Romanian lessons at https://www.garzoni.app/ro/learn).
- Built for young adults in the UK; examples use pounds (£) and UK rules (ISAs, National Insurance, payslips). Also used in Romania.
- Plans: Starter is free (3 learning activities a day, no payment card). Plus is £6.99/month or £59.99/year. Pro is £7.99/month or £69.99/year and adds the voice tutor and receipt scanning.
- Written and edited by founder Andrei Neagoe: https://www.garzoni.app/authors/andrei-neagoe. How lessons are researched and reviewed: https://www.garzoni.app/editorial-standards

## Core Topics
- Budgeting: building a budget, the 50/30/20 rule, tracking spending
- Saving: emergency funds, savings goals, habit formation
- Debt management: avalanche vs snowball payoff strategies
- Investing basics: stocks, bonds, ETFs, compound interest, starting small
- Credit scores: understanding, monitoring, and improving credit
- Taxes: fundamentals explained in plain language
- AI financial coaching: personalised, interactive guidance in simulators

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://www.garzoni.app/): Overview of Garzoni
- [Free Lessons](https://www.garzoni.app/learn): Catalog of free finance lessons
- [Guides & Comparisons](https://www.garzoni.app/guides): In-depth guides, app comparisons (e.g. vs YNAB, Monzo, Cleo, Monarch, Acorns), and plain-English answers
- [Compound interest calculator](https://www.garzoni.app/calculators/compound-interest): Free calculator — starting sum plus monthly saving at any rate, in £ (Romanian version in lei at /ro/calculators/compound-interest)
- [Savings goal calculator](https://www.garzoni.app/calculators/savings-goal): Free calculator — how much to save each month to reach a target by a deadline, or how long a monthly amount takes, with interest, in £ (Romanian version in lei at /ro/calculators/savings-goal)
- [50/30/20 budget calculator](https://www.garzoni.app/calculators/50-30-20-budget): Free calculator — splits monthly take-home pay into needs, wants and savings, and rebuilds the split around what essentials really cost, in £ (Romanian version in lei at /ro/calculators/50-30-20-budget)
- [Romanian lessons](https://www.garzoni.app/ro/learn): Lecții de educație financiară în limba română
- [About](https://www.garzoni.app/about): Mission and approach
- [Author](https://www.garzoni.app/authors/andrei-neagoe): Who writes the lessons
- [Features](https://www.garzoni.app/marketing): Product features
- [Pricing](https://www.garzoni.app/subscriptions): Plans (free Starter tier available)
- [Full Content Corpus](https://www.garzoni.app/llms-full.txt): Plain-text of all public lessons and guides for LLM ingestion
